summary: Full backend + frontend testing for the Família Orçamento Expo app. All backend endpoints and frontend flows exercised against the public preview URL work correctly end-to-end.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs` instead. Non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Optional: migrate expo-router/unstable-native-tabs -> expo-router/native-tabs to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown; works but should migrate to lifespan handlers.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is accepted by Starlette but is not spec-compliant; harmless for this app (Bearer tokens, no cookies).
Member/category delete does not cascade entries for other months of other years explicitly, but $or filter in apply_all is correct; delete handlers already purge entries for ref_id (good).
seed_data_creation: Verified user_test01 + family_id (seeded by previous iteration, 4 members + 23 categories present). Created user_test02 (family_id=null) with session_token test_session_token_02 to test onboarding; reset to family_id=null after test. Cleared test01 entries and reset member default_income to 0 after UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date is Oct 2026; app default month shows Outubro 2026. Use Bearer test_session_token_01 (user_test01, family already seeded). For onboarding tests re-seed test_session_token_02 with family_id=null via mongosh. family-code-input testID only renders after tapping onboarding-join-option.

frontend: tap row-<id> opens editar modal with editar-value-input + editar-save-all-button (member row)
save-all persists default_income (verified R$1.500,00 shown as 'Igual todo mês')
ano tab shows year-income, year-expenses, year-balance, year-chart, year-breakdown
onboarding screen renders create/join options + submit for user with family_id=null
onboarding join by code transitions user to home-screen
